_comment_prefix: pr-checks.yml only allows feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore|ci: title prefixes — 'deps:' is rejected, hence chore:.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

_comment_grouping: Patch and minor bumps are grouped into one PR a month so the soak has a single thing to watch. Majors stay separate and unscheduled — this project bumps by blast radius (one big bump is what broke v7.8), so each major gets its own review and soak.

packageRules._comment: Majors require an explicit click on the dependency dashboard before a PR opens. fastapi/starlette and cryptography are both sitting on major crossings — see security/audit_baseline.json.
Telegram API surface — Tier B in the dep plan. v7.8 crashed prod from an unreviewed bump of this package. Never auto-open; scripts/smoke_test.py and scripts/functional_test_4_34.py are the gate.

vulnerabilityAlerts._comment: Security fixes bypass the monthly schedule — they open immediately.
